purpose: Replace type-only labels for the Type-0x2F, Type-0x3A, and Type-0x11/0x12 player-response paths.

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_StageType84ActionResponse

contract.dispatch: Player-collision entry for runtime actor type 0x2F
contract.setup: Installs the Type-0x84 response animation at 0x00123A96 and clears its transient field
contract.ordinary: With PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD clear, routes through Player_ProcessInteractionState
contract.action: With the action gate set, optionally queues event 0x21 and allocates a forward-slot Type-0x84 companion while copying source X/Y

evidence: Exact 112-byte body ending at the internal branch boundary before 0x001AEE18
Direct Type-0x84 animation-root write and PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD gate
Direct ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84 load and event-0x21 audio path

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_AdvanceSecondaryResponse

contract.dispatch: Player-collision entry for runtime actor type 0x3A
contract.counter: Checks for exhausted INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS and advances it through InteractionCounter_AdvanceSecondaryDigits
contract.publication: Publishes the interaction value when the counter is 0x3939
contract.response: Optionally queues event 0x0D and transfers to PlayerCollision_ReinitializeResponseActor

evidence: Exact 58-byte tail-entry body ending at the branch into the shared reinitializer
Direct INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS comparison and advance call
Direct event-0x0D audio and shared response-template tail transfer

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ProcessInteractionResponse

contract.dispatch: Shared player-collision entry for runtime actor types 0x11 and 0x12
contract.launch: With PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD set, selects horizontal velocity from actor/player X ordering, writes PLAYER_VY=-0x0400, and installs PLAYER_ANIM_TRANSITION_FLAG_RESPONSE
contract.terrain: Sets camera thresholds, arms TERRAIN_RESPONSE_ACTIVE, and clears TERRAIN_VERTICAL_STOP and TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER_STATE
contract.interaction: With the action gate clear, handles Type-0x12's interaction animation and the camera/recovery interaction branches

evidence: Direct PLAYER_VX/PLAYER_VY, PLAYER_ANIMATION_PC, camera-threshold, and terrain-response writes
Direct Type-0x12 animation-root reference and Player_ProcessInteractionState call

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish Type-0x84 action staging, secondary interaction progression, and the shared player interaction/launch response while retaining dispatch-type aliases.
